decision: Do not treat Haze overlap synchronization or one-sided input clipping as established Rain fixes. Inspect training-side fine-detail errors before choosing a bounded FLUX update. Haze end-to-end rerun deferred until all five categories pass.
limitations: Official benchmark is adaptively reused, not an independent blind test.
32-block oracle is a specific diagnostic projection, not a bound on all possible low-frequency methods.
Overlap disagreement also varies with seed and crop-relative positions.
